text: Single-spectrum annotation overlaid Spectrum view (R/fct_annotate.R + mod_plot_spectrum). commonMZ (GitHub-, hence Remotes: field) adduct/fragment dictionary; InterpretMSSpectrum::findMAIN auto ranker — hard Imports. Three modes share one dictionary manual auto annotate identically: - Manual anchor — user designates peak known ion; invert neutral mass (m/z = (nmol·M + massdiff)/|charge|, massdiff commonMZ::MZ_CAMERA) project adducts + M+1 isotopes + -source neutral losses (commonMZ::adducts_fragments), matching within shared ppm/Da tol. - Auto-suggest — findMAIN (constrained commonMZ’s quasi-molecular adducts) ranks (M, main-adduct) hypotheses; chosen row fills anchor. - Difference network — peak pairs whose Δm/z matches dictionary entry. title: Architecture review — xcmsVisGUI
text: Raw files may centroided profile. Profile effectively unusable: one Orbitrap MS1 scan ~17k detector samples (Spectrum view drew ~17k m/z sticks) whole file ~29M points / 690 MB, MS map read full throwing away top 200k intensity — .e. kept peak flanks. Design. Peak picking data processing, owned per view, filter global setting — control lives Spectrum MS map panels centroid_spec(mode, snr, hws, k) passed apply_filters_spectra(sp, f, cp) extract_*(..., cp). (began life filter$centroid field; moved user pointed processing, spectrum selection — also made filter-equivalence invariant clean : cp = NULL ⇒ pure filter.) apply_filters_spectra peak-picks via Spectra::pickPeaks(), lazy step — nothing materialises view reads peaks. Measured real Orbitrap file: spectrum 19,720 → 1,369 points; MS map 28.8M → 2.0M rows (690 → 48 MB); base peak’s m/z unchanged, picking costs mass accuracy. exposed knobs pickPeaks’ snr / halfWindowSize / k (m/z refinement); method / descending / threshold left defaults. Four decisions worth keeping: - Per view, per-view defaults. MS map must peak-pick (raw difference usable ) defaults auto; Spectrum view opens raw trace () came look data one scan cheap. view centroid_controls_ui / read_centroid_spec (shared, utils_reactive.R); cross-view coupling. - Detect per MS LEVEL, per file. Mixed files (profile MS1 + centroided MS2) routine Thermo DDA — msdata’s MS3TMT11.mzML one. Peak-picking file wholesale destructive: local-maximum detection already-centroided spectrum discards every peak whose neighbour intense. profile_ms_levels() resolves profile levels hands pickPeaks(msLevel. = …), leaving centroided levels bit--bit untouched (asserted test-filters.R). Detection prefers file’s centroided flag falls back Spectra::isCentroided() shape-sniffing absent (CDF); undecidable → treat centroided, never pick guess. - Chromatograms never centroided. apply_filters (TIC/BPC/EIC) takes cp: chromatogram sums/maxes intensity across m/z window, correct profile samples reproduces instrument’s TIC (verified identical without picking). picking separate cp arg rather filter field, apply_filters_spectra(sp, f) cp pure filter matches apply_filters exactly — equivalence battery just omits cp. - Raw profile drawn line, sticks — profile data — peak clicks snap apex (PROFILE_SNAP_DA) m/z sent EIC list / annotation anchor peak’s, whichever flank sample hit. Gotcha: Spectra::pickPeaks must namespace-qualified. Attaching xcms brings MSnbase pickPeaks generic masks ProtGenerics’, bare call fails dispatch Spectra object.

what: THE performance story (most important thing here)
title: CLAUDE.md — working notes for xcmsVisGUI
text: Benchmarked: Spectra(MsBackendMzR()) / xcms::chromatogram() took 80–150 s/file real mzML. Root cause = BiocParallel: MsBackendMzR::backendInitialize reads headers via bplapply(files, ..., BPPARAM = bpparam()), Windows default SnowParam(6) — spawns socket cluster (worker reloading Bioc stack) per call. Fix: register(SerialParam()) → 0.2–1.6 s. Done .onLoad (R/zzz.R) every read path (app test suite) gets . Consequences baked architecture: - .onLoad (R/zzz.R) calls BiocParallel::register(SerialParam()). remove . (run_app() adds mirai daemon pool + large-upload option; daemons spawned package load.) - File-list header summaries read raw mzR (read_ms_header, ~0.1 s) mirai workers — even SerialParam Spectra reads ~5 s/file, slow 100+ files. Workers library(mzR) (BiocParallel). - Heavy plotting/filtering uses Spectra/xcms main process SerialParam (chromatogram, extract_peaks, extract_spectrum, filters). regains full Spectra filter set. - Git history preserves alternatives: Spectra baseline (commit Spectra/xcms baseline) pure-mzR version (commit Replace Spectra data layer direct mzR). Spectra fixes SnowParam default upstream, SerialParam workaround can dropped.

text: Import policy: every used function declared per-function @importFrom code calls bare names. Two deliberate exceptions: shiny bslib imported whole (@import) — UI framework used essentially every function conflicts imports; enumerating per function adds noise, safety. RforMassSpectrometry S4 stack (Spectra/xcms/MsExperiment/BiocParallel/ mzR) called ::. packages export many overlapping generics (rtime, intensity, mz, filterMsLevel, spectra, ...) collide base (close, filter); :: keeps intended method source explicit dispatch unambiguous — "unresolvable conflict" case. %>% (magrittr) %||% (rlang) imported operators.
